description:
Dolt is a SQL database that you can fork, clone, branch, merge, push and pull just like a git repository.

Dolt is a SQL database that you can fork, clone, branch, merge, push and pull just like a git repository.
Connect to Dolt just like any MySQL database to run queries or update the data using SQL commands.
Use the command line interface to import CSV files, commit your changes, push them to a remote, or merge your teammate's changes.
Merged PRs
dolt
- 12152: Fix schema merge conflicts for checks on mixed-case columns
  Resolve CHECK column references case-insensitively during schema merges, preventing false deleted-column conflicts for mixed-case column names.
- 12136: go/go.mod: Bump dolthub/file-locks.
  Restores support for building on *BSDs.
- 12131: Project rows in DOLT_LOG
  LogTable implements ProjectedNode, because it needs to detect which columns have been selected so it knows which values to compute. But it doesn't trim columns based on the projection. This prevents us from being able to remove Project nodes on DOLT_LOG system table queries.
  When combined with dolthub/go-mysql-server#4011, this would have resulted in pruning the columnSet for DOLT_LOG without pruning the schema, which would result in incorrect offset cacluation during assignExecOffsets. This change prevents that interaction.
- 11934: Expose PostgreSQL session settings through Dolt sessions
Closed Issues
- 12056: SyncRoots returns success when reading the source root fails (DOLT_BACKUP sync/restore report success)
